summary: Implemented module-level open and wrap_file plus Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file in rich/progress.py, with private _BinaryFileReader and _ProgressContext helpers. Added 14 tests to tests/test_progress.py, a "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" section in docs/source/progress.rst, and a changelog bullet for PR 1759. Changes are uncommitted. Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and black were not executed, so verification is still outstanding. Choices to review: mode and name properties were added to the reader because typing.IO declares them abstract; the mypy codes used are no-untyped-def and override; the module-level implementation takes mode as Any to call the overloaded Progress.open; and the context wrapper stops the display if entering the reader fails.
